content.rendered:
We are so excited that volunteers are again being welcomed into the building and classrooms. There are many areas in which you can support the students and staff, but there are a few steps that every volunteer needs to accomplish beforehand: 

  1. Please fill out your district background check. Remember to click the “submit” button at the end! A background check needs to be completed each year and can take up to 10 days to clear.  Please email volunteers@hawksviewpac.org when submitted, so we know to keep watch for your background check status.
  2. Submit proof of vaccination or a vaccination exception form to the office.  Exception forms can be found here:  Medical Exception Request or Religious Exception request.  Exception forms will need to be approved by our district office prior to volunteering.
  3. Download the HelpCounter app! Please create a login and check the boxes for the areas in which you’d like to help. If you already have a HelpCounter account, please update your preferences so we know to contact you when specific needs become available. Examples of areas of interest include: popcorn day, picture day, bulletin boards, Art Lit, field trips and lots more! 
  4. If you have questions please reach out to volunteers@hawksviewpac.org.

Here is a link to the PAC website, which has all the links you need to get involved! We can’t wait to see parents and community members helping out! 

https://www.hawksviewpac.org/get-involved
